description: Keyword search over the ShopSavvy catalog. Returns ranked products (title, brand, identifiers and ShopSavvy ID), best match first, paginated with limit (default 20, max 100) and offset. Use it when the user names a product type or partial name; use product_lookup for an exact barcode, ASIN or URL, and universal_search for broad 'best X' category questions where reviews help. Free without an API key; 1 credit per product returned with a key. If no products match, say so; do not invent products.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 100)

query.description: Search query or keyword (e.g., 'iphone 15 pro', 'samsung tv', 'nike shoes')

name: product_search
title: Search products
